name: Vesper Velvetcap
title: The starter
description: A steady hand for a first run: a sturdy front rank, and a burst of spores to break a push.

passive.text: Home Brood: your squads on front-rank plots have +10% HP and damage.

power.name: Spore Burst
power.text: 90 crush damage to every enemy unit within 2 tiles of a point, emplacements included.

name: Armilla the Vast
title: The landholder
description: Slow, heavy and greedy for ground: her colony has an extra plot from the first battle, and her roots draw gold from every kill in a clash.

passive.text: Landholder: your colony has 1 more plot, in the third rank, from battle 1.

power.name: Rhizome Tithe
power.text: +2 gold for each supply of enemy units killed so far in this clash, credited at once. Fire it late for more, but before the last kill.

name: Cordis the Puppeteer
title: The merger
description: Knits small units into big ones: her merged units are tougher, and a bloom lifts a crowd a tier mid-fight.

passive.text: Merged units start with +10% HP, and units merge from 2 tiles apart.

power.name: Puppet Bloom
power.text: Lifts each of your units within 3 tiles of a point one merge tier, even in combat: a unit becomes Bloomed, a Bloomed unit an Elder.
